rows.text: # Chromosome theory of inheritance ## 1. Introduction Opening frame for **Chromosome theory of inheritance** — what the topic is, why it matters, a real-world hook (Nepal where possible), the map of what follows, and the learning outcomes (biology-plan.md §3.1, block I). Prose depth is written in the Heredity and Evolution fill pass. ## 2.…  ·  Mendel's factors were invisible abstractions in 1866. Forty years later, two young researchers — **Walter Sutton** (USA) and **Theodor Boveri** (Germany), working independently in 1902–1903 — pointed out that Mendel's factors behave *exactly* like chromosomes do during meiosis. This is the **chromosome theory of inheritance (Sutton–Boveri theory)**: genes are carried on chromosomes.…

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Sutton and Boveri united Mendel with meiosis: genes are on chromosomes; segregation parallels homologue separation in anaphase-I; independent assortment parallels random metaphase alignment.  ·  Trick 2: Two parallels to quote: (1) alleles pair → homologous chromosome pair; (2) allele separation → anaphase-I disjunction.
